items.title: File Einspruch against the 2025 income tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch ist innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids beim Finanzamt Musterhafen, Kaistraße 1, 27568 Musterhafen, schriftlich oder elektronisch einzulegen oder dort zur Niederschrift zu erklären.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 21.05.2026, sent by ordinary post by a tax authority. Deemed delivery is the 4th day after posting (§ 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO) = Mon 25.05.2026, which is Pfingstmontag (public holiday, nationwide), so delivery shifts to the next working day, Tue 26.05.2026. Counting of the one-month objection period starts the following day (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO), i.e. 27.05.2026, and ends one month later on the day matching the delivery date's number, Fri 26.06.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB / § 355 AO). 26.06.2026 is a Friday and not a holiday in NW, so the deadline stays there.

items.title: Receive tax refund (Erstattung) to the known bank account
items.quote: Die Auszahlung erfolgt in den nächsten Tagen auf das bekannte Konto.
items.computation: The letter states only that payout will follow 'in den nächsten Tagen' (in the coming days) without a fixed calendar date, so no exact due date can be determined; this is an expected inbound payment, not an obligation on the recipient.

warnings: No exact payout date is given for the 793,00 € refund ('in den nächsten Tagen'), so its due date could not be computed and is left as an estimate/reminder only.

The IBAN printed in the letter footer (DE26 2905 0000 0008 8007 70) belongs to the Finanzamt itself for information/contact purposes — the refund goes to the taxpayer's 'bekanntes Konto' (account already on file), not to this IBAN, so it should not be used to send any payment.
